snippet.title: CGR Trailers - SNIPER: GHOST WARRIOR 2 Siberian Strike DLC Trailer
snippet.description: Sniper: Ghost Warrior 2 Siberian Strike DLC trailer. CGR Trailers, from Classic Game Room®, presents a trailer for the "Siberian Strike" DLC trailer for SNIPER: GHOST WARRIOR 2 from City Interactive. This expansion pack/add-on takes players to the frozen landscape of Siberia. This DLC is available for download today, March 27, 2013. It will be out on the PC/Steam, PlayStation 3 (PS3)/PlayStation Network (PSN) and the Xbox 360/Xbox Live Arcade (XBLA). This is the PEGI version of the trailer. Enjoy!
